summary: Concurrency-safe status (cancel-wins) shipped in daemon.js /overlay/status: (1) optimistic CAS — if body.expected_status set and differs from current overlay status, return 409 {current,expected} (stops last-write-wins). (2) 'canceled' is terminal — leaving it (e.g. ->in_progress) returns 409 unless body.force/reopen. (3) cancel_requested[key]=ISO advisory flag set on cancel, cleared on force-reopen; surfaced in /task/detail. overlay.js EMPTY() gained cancel_requested:{} (load() spread back-fills old files; persisted via existing atomic save). mcp-core.js set_status gained expected_status+force params. smoke.sh: 7 assertions (cancel sets flag, heartbeat blocked, force reopens, flag cleared, CAS 409 + match). Note: a separate linter edit added guidance:[] to EMPTY() — left intact. Smoke 23/23.
